engineDropCounterScope: Final aggregate includes all TUN traffic and lifecycle; no per-reason evidence in these runs. Nonzero counts preserved; not a zero-engine-drop claim.

packetAfterFixCapture.correlationLimit: inner TLS correlated on USB and exit-to-origin only; packet tunnel uplink encrypted; byte counts not integrity proof

summary.downloadPolicy: Timed 20-second HTTP200 downloads can pass throughput criteria with partial bodies; not all downloads are full-file transfers.
